subject: Finova Dedicated Capacity sizing follow-up & PoC next steps
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finova.com>, Lina Gomez <lina@finova.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 Nov 2025 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Dedicated capacity sizing questions and next steps

Hi Samir / Lina —

Thanks again for the productive call today. Quick recap and a few follow-ups to help us size Dedicated capacity (and confirm whether Dedicated or Private VPC is the right path for Finova):

1) Primary constraints you mentioned
- Compliance: PCI-adjacent processing, auditability required (SOC2/ISO evidence)
- Latency: target p95 <= 200ms for primary product flows
- Traffic shape: large daytime peaks driven by batch renewal jobs plus steady chat traffic

2) Info we need to size Dedicated capacity precisely (please fill the attached sizing sheet if you can):
- Peak TPS (inference requests per second) and steady TPS
- Typical and max concurrency per model (how many simultaneous sessions/requests you expect)
- Token mix: average prompt tokens, average generation tokens, and % of long-context sessions (>1k tokens)
- Preferred model(s) or families (e.g., Llama 3 70B, Mistral X) and whether you plan to use quantized variants
- Any non-batchable workloads (low-latency single-token streaming) vs highly batchable requests

3) Rough guidance from our side (will refine after we get your numbers):
- For Llama 70B-class models, H100 80GB nodes typically give higher throughput and lower latency than A100 for FP16/INT8 inference, but customer pricing/availability can change the recommendation
- Example starting point: 4x H100 (public Dedicated) or 8x A100 can support ~30–70 TPS depending on batch strategy and token mix; we’ll run microbenchmarks in the PoC

Next steps: please return the attached "redwood-dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx" with the TPS / concurrency / token mix fields filled. Once we have that, we’ll:
- Propose a concrete Dedicated node counts and GPU type (H100 vs A100) with expected p95 latency and cost estimate
- Share a 4‑week PoC plan (benchmarks + production-like test harness) and an updated Mutual Action Plan in HubSpot

Let me know if Dedicated looks like the right fit vs Private VPC (you mentioned procurement preferences). Happy to jump on a 30m follow-up to walk the template with your infra team.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: redwood-dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finova.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lina Gomez <lina@finova.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Dedicated capacity sizing questions and next steps

Camila —

Thanks for the recap and the template. I filled the key fields inline below and attached our network diagram and a short procurement timeline. High-level answers:

- Peak TPS: 50 TPS (measured as individual generation requests/sec)
- Steady TPS: ~20 TPS
- Concurrency: typical concurrency per model 8–12 (we have ~10 hot sessions during peak), backlog can spike to 25 for short windows
- Token mix: avg prompt 250 tokens, avg generation 200 tokens, ~5% of requests are long-context (1.5k–2.5k tokens)
- Models: planning to use Llama 3 70B quantized (8-bit) for most flows; evaluating a smaller 13B for low-cost routes
- Batchability: most inference calls are easily batchable (stateless prompts), but chat streaming for sessions must stay low-latency (~target p95 200ms)
- Latency SLO: p95 <= 200ms, p99 <= 500ms (internally desirable but flexible for long-context requests)
- Compliance: prefer Dedicated Reserved capacity in our cloud region (us-west) unless Private VPC simplifies audits — procurement will push for Private if it reduces contractual risk

We can support a 4-week PoC starting Nov 17. Procurement timeline: POC approval Nov 10–14, order by Nov 24.

Attachments: finova-network-diagram.pdf, finova-poc-requirements.xlsx

On the GPU question — we don’t have an internal preference yet; cost vs perf will drive the decision. Please include both H100 and A100 configs in the sizing/quote.

Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering | Finova Payments
samir.patel@finova.com
+1 (408) 555-3342

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finova.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Dedicated capacity sizing questions and next steps

Samir — thanks for the detail, that’s very helpful. A few clarifying notes and what we’ll commit to for the PoC: 

Clarifying Qs (quick):
- For the 5% long-context requests, are those spread across the day or concentrated (e.g., end-of-day batch jobs)?
- When you say "backlog spike to 25", is that concurrent active requests or queued requests waiting for GPU slots?

What we’ll deliver for the PoC (Nov 17 start):
- Two benchmark tracks: (A) Llama 3 70B quantized on H100 (FP16/INT8 paths) and (B) Llama 3 70B on A100 for cost comparison. Each track will report TPS, p50/p95/p99 latencies, and cost per 1k tokens.
- Target cluster configs to validate: 4x H100-80GB (conservative low-node test) and 8x A100-80GB (cost-optimized test). We’ll also provide a quoted mid-point (6x H100 equiv) if you want a blended option.
- Testing scenarios: steady 20 TPS, controlled ramp to 50 TPS, and a long-context test representing the 5% flows. We’ll include burst/queue behavior so you can see graceful degradation and fallback to smaller quantized variants.
- Security/compliance: we’ll include SOC2 audit artifacts and a copy of our data handling addendum. If you decide Private VPC, we’ll map the audit artifact differences in the MAP doc.

Requests from you to make the benchmarks accurate:
- Fill the attached template with expected request sizes by route (we got most but a few route-level splits are missing)
- If possible, grant a short-running read-only test account so we can run real tokenization and batching tests against a subset of your traffic patterns

I’ll draft the Mutual Action Plan in HubSpot and add estimated timelines/costs for both Dedicated and Private VPC paths. Aditya / Vivek — looping you to confirm we can deliver the two GPU tracks and to prepare a draft quote for both H100 and A100 nodal counts.

If helpful I can hop on a 30-minute call Wed to review the test matrix.

Cheers,
Camila
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Camila / Aditya / Vivek —

This all looks good. Quick answers to your clarifying Qs:
- The 5% long-context requests are mostly spread throughout the day (customer support contexts) with small concentration at end-of-day reconciliation (about ~30 minutes).
- The backlog spike refers to concurrent active requests at peak; when it hits ~25 we start queuing and see latency creep.

We’re aligned to proceed with the PoC Nov 17. Please send a preliminary quote that includes:
- 4x H100 configuration (per-month estimate)
- 8x A100 configuration (per-month estimate)
- Cost for Private VPC option (one-time setup + monthly infra fee)
- SOC2 compliance add-on and pricing for extended audit artifacts (if any)

Attaching our standard PO template to speed procurement. If you can get the quote to us by Nov 12 that would keep us on the Nov 24 ordering date.

Thanks — looking forward.

Samir
